payload.recallText: Hi. I grew up on rhode islands. We were not more than 20 miles from the kennedys. We were irish, they were irish. We were Christians, they were Christians. They were like a distant family. So this one night after thanksgiving, we heard on the radio about the jfk assasination. I started crying in the back seat. My sister told my father and he pulled over on the I95, looked back at us with tears in his eyes and said to never be ashamed to cry
